cli.description: 6-max preflop position matrix heatmap (theory / Hero / player pool)
cli.help.hands: GG hand history folder (scanned recursively for .txt)
cli.help.ranges: theory ranges folder (.txt). If omitted, uses the {env} environment variable, then the default folder {default}
cli.help.title: page title (default {default})
cli.help.json: also save the matrix data as JSON
cli.help.lang: output language: zh-Hant, zh-Hans or en (zh-TW and zh-CN also accepted; defaults to the system language)
cli.help.top: rows per group (player pool, Hero) in the deviation summary, 0 to 20 (default {default}, 0 hides it)
cli.help.check_ranges: only check how complete the theory ranges folder is, no report (exit code: complete 0, incomplete 1, folder missing or bad option 2)
cli.help.init_ranges: create blank range file name templates in DIR without overwriting existing files, no report
cli.hint.default: ; specify one with --ranges, set the {env} environment variable, or put the range files in {default} (see docs/RANGES.md)
cli.error.hands_dir: Hand history folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
cli.error.ranges_dir: Theory ranges folder does not exist or is not a folder (source: {origin}): {path}{hint}
cli.error.same_output: --json and -o cannot point to the same file
cli.error.no_hands: No usable hands under {dir} (need GG-format 6-max .txt files)
cli.error.hands_required: --hands is required to generate a report
cli.error.lang_invalid: --lang accepts zh-Hant, zh-Hans or en (zh-TW and zh-CN also accepted): {value}
cli.error.top_range: --top must be an integer from 0 to 20: {value}
cli.error.mode_conflict: --check-ranges and --init-ranges cannot be combined with each other or with report options (--hands, -o, --json, --hero, --title)
cli.error.init_failed: Cannot create range file name templates: {err}
cli.error.no_home: Cannot determine the user home or config folder: {err} (use --ranges to specify the ranges folder)
cli.warning.no_hero: No hand has a player named {hero}, so the "me" column will be empty (use --hero to set the name)
cli.hands_summary: Hands: scanned {files} file(s), kept {hands} hand(s); skipped {duplicates} duplicate(s), excluded {not_six_max} non-6-max, skipped {unparseable} unparseable, {unreadable} unreadable file(s)
cli.ranges_summary: Theory ranges: {files} file(s), mapped to {nodes} node(s); ignored (multiway or unrecognized) {ignored}, duplicates {duplicates}, unreadable {unreadable}, unfilled (blank files) {unfilled}
cli.ranges_duplicate: Duplicate node file (only the first is used): {item}
cli.check.summary: {have}/{required} required actions present; {nodes} node files mapped (standard set: {standard})
cli.init.summary: Range file name templates: {created} created, {skipped} skipped ({dir})
